title: Haryana Economy: Agriculture, Livestock, Industry and Transport: Quiz

questions.question: Where is the National Dairy Research Institute (NDRI) located?
questions.rationale: NDRI moved to Karnal in 1955 and has been a deemed university since 1989. CIRB, the buffalo institute, is at Hisar.

questions.question: CCS Haryana Agricultural University is located at:
questions.rationale: CCS HAU is at Hisar. It began as Haryana Agricultural University in 1970 and took Chaudhary Charan Singh's name in 1991.

questions.question: Which of the following is a buffalo breed native to Haryana?
questions.rationale: Murrah is the buffalo breed from the Rohtak-Hisar-Jind region. Hariana is a cattle breed, and Sahiwal and Gir are cattle breeds from elsewhere.

questions.question: Which pairing of Haryana livestock research bodies and cities is correct?
options: National Research Centre on Equines - Hisar
Central Institute for Research on Buffaloes - Karnal
questions.rationale: The Equines Research Centre, CIRB and LUVAS are at Hisar, while NDRI is at Karnal.

questions.question: In which year was the Green Revolution era Bhakra Dam completed, an event that boosted irrigation for Haryana?
questions.rationale: The Bhakra Dam was completed in 1963 and, along with the Western Yamuna Command network of the 1970s, raised foodgrain output.

questions.question: Haryana is known as a major exporter of which type of rice?
questions.rationale: Haryana contributes about 60 per cent of India's basmati rice exports, mainly from the Karnal, Kaithal and Kurukshetra belt.

questions.question: According to the Economic Survey of Haryana 2024-25, which statement about per capita income in 2024-25 (advance estimate, current prices) is correct?
options: It was below the national average
It was exactly equal to the national average
It was about 3.53 lakh rupees, above India's figure of about 2.06 lakh
questions.rationale: The Survey gives 3,53,182 rupees for Haryana against 2,05,579 rupees for India. 1.15 lakh is the national figure at constant prices.

questions.question: Which sector contributed the largest share of Haryana's GSVA in 2024-25 at constant 2011-12 prices?
questions.rationale: Services made up 51.2 per cent, industry 32.9 per cent and agriculture and allied activities 15.9 per cent.

questions.question: Which town is known for handloom textiles, carpets and a large Indian Oil refinery?
questions.rationale: Panipat is called the city of weavers and also hosts the Panipat Refinery. Yamunanagar is known for paper and plywood.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT correctly matched with an industrial town of Haryana?
options: Gurugram - corporate offices and IT services
questions.rationale: The refinery is at Panipat, not Hisar. Hisar is better known for agricultural universities and livestock research.

questions.question: The agency that builds and allots industrial estates and IMTs in Haryana is:
questions.rationale: HSIIDC (Haryana State Industrial and Infrastructure Development Corporation) was set up in 1967 and is based at Panchkula.

questions.question: The Kundli-Manesar-Palwal (KMP) Expressway is best described as:
options: An expressway of about 135 km that forms a ring around Delhi
An airport link road at Hisar
questions.rationale: KMP, also called the Western Peripheral Expressway, runs about 135 km and links Sonipat, Gurugram and Faridabad areas, helping traffic bypass Delhi.

questions.question: The old Grand Trunk Road passing through Ambala, Karnal, Panipat and Sonipat is now part of which national highway?
questions.rationale: The GT Road corridor through northern Haryana is now NH-44. NH-48 runs from Delhi through Gurugram toward Jaipur.

questions.question: Which crop is grown mainly in the southwestern districts of Sirsa, Fatehabad and Hisar?
questions.rationale: Cotton is a major kharif crop of the dry southwest. Tea, jute and coffee are not grown in Haryana.
